evidence_plan.requirement: repetitive and time-consuming activities handled by the assistant

payload.reason: The evidence clearly identifies the types of repetitive and time-consuming activities that the assistant handles, specifically in the context of Intelligent Process Automation and Robotic Process Automation.

claims.text: The assistant handles repetitive, routine, and low-cognitive tasks, such as data entry and processing straightforward workflows.
The assistant reduces waiting times for students and tutors by processing questions more efficiently.
The assistant allows workers to focus on more complex and cognitively demanding tasks by taking care of repetitive activities.
